summary: DentAkademi has clear prices, CQC and GDC details and an AI Smile Passport tool. A few visible errors and conflicting booking buttons weaken a modern first impression.

findings.problem: The Patient Stories heading appears with no stories under it, and the Before and After page is only linked in the footer with nothing on the homepage.
findings.cost: Patients choosing an implant or smile makeover clinic look for people like them. An empty stories section looks like there are none.
findings.fix: Real patient stories and captioned before and after cases on the homepage.

findings.problem: Headings show literal underscores, such as Where _exceptional_ smiles begin and Your Smile _Passport_. Footnote markers such as vs avg london* have no matching footnote text.
findings.cost: Leftover formatting and unexplained claims make price comparisons look unsupported.
findings.fix: Clean headings and visible footnotes that back every claim.

findings.problem: The hero Book a Consultation goes to /book-pay/, but the floating Book Online button goes to /contact/. Booking, WhatsApp and the AI chat all compete for attention.
findings.cost: Two different booking destinations confuse patients and split your enquiries.
findings.fix: One clear booking path with WhatsApp as the second option.

findings.problem: The GCR Top 10 Worldwide counter is unexplained, Bespoke pricing for Smile Makeover gives no anchor, and social icons are empty links with no labels.
findings.cost: Unexplained badges raise doubts, and a missing price anchor stops patients asking.
findings.fix: Explain the award, show a from price and label every link.

redesign: A proof first homepage with real patient stories, captioned results and your CQC and GDC details beside every booking button.
One booking path with WhatsApp, and the Smile Passport placed near the top as your lead tool.
Treatment pages written to rank for searches like dental implants Marylebone and Invisalign London.
